description: Watches one token for a window with risk alerts (dev wallet sells, a top holder sells a large share, liquidity pulled, authorities changed, a new wallet cluster), by webhook or by polling get_job. The window on sale is 24 hours. Paid: partner key or x402.

hours.description: the window in hours; 24 is the window on sale

token.description: the token address: a Solana mint (base58) or a Base contract (0x and 40 hex)

webhook.description: optional public https url that receives each alert as a JSON POST

name: monitor_token
title: Watch a token
